description: Phase 6ac gate — CREATE VIEW / DROP VIEW (read-only views, compile-time SELECT substitution).

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, v INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30);
CREATE VIEW v_big AS SELECT id, v FROM t WHERE v >= 20;
SELECT id, v FROM v_big ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE t (g INTEGER, v INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (1, 20), (2, 30);
CREATE VIEW v_sum AS SELECT g, SUM(v) AS total FROM t GROUP BY g;
SELECT g, total FROM v_sum ORDER BY g;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10);
CREATE VIEW v_renamed (x, y) AS SELECT a, b FROM t;
SELECT x, y FROM v_renamed;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT a FROM t;
DROP VIEW v1;
SELECT a FROM v1;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS does_not_exist;
DROP VIEW not_there;

cases.name: view-cannot-insert
cases.description: Read-only views — INSERT into a view must fail (v1 non-goal).

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT a FROM t;
INSERT INTO v1 VALUES (1);
CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER, score INTEGER);
INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b');
INSERT INTO t2 VALUES (1, 100), (2, 200);
CREATE VIEW v_joined AS SELECT t1.id, t1.name, t2.score FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.id;
SELECT id, name, score FROM v_joined ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT a FROM t;
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v1 AS SELECT a FROM t;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER);
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT a FROM t;
CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT a FROM t;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
CREATE VIEW v1 (x) AS SELECT a, b FROM t;
